summary: Using an unsupported field with --field-selector returns an error listing the supported selectors (for Device: metadata.alias, metadata.nameoralias, status.* etc.); examples include `metadata.alias contains cluster`, excluding a device with `metadata.name!=...`, and filtering by owner, labels and creation timestamp.
